The *Phussabuddhavaṁsa* ("The History of the Buddha Phussa") is the twentieth chapter of the canonical *Buddhavaṁsa*, cataloged under the late sutta collections of the Khuddaka Nikāya [SuttaCentral]. It forms part of the verse chronicle detailing the lineage, biography, and dispensation of the past Buddha Phussa [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral records two translations of the text in two languages [SuttaCentral].

DharmaNexus identifies extensive formulaic text reuse between the *Phussabuddhavaṁsa* and other Pali works, documenting 396 matches across 30 texts [DharmaNexus]. Its closest alignment is with its commentary, the *Buddhavaṁsa-aṭṭhakathā* (163 matches, with a prominent correspondence between §8.1–14.2 and §3251–3264_0) [DharmaNexus]. It also shares substantial recurring biographical verse sequences with other *Buddhavaṁsa* chapters, such as the *Koṇḍaññabuddhavaṁsa* (Bv 4), *Sumedhabuddhavaṁsa* (Bv 13), *Sikhībuddhavaṁsa* (Bv 22), *Sujātabuddhavaṁsa* (Bv 14), *Atthadassībuddhavaṁsa* (Bv 16), and *Maṅgalabuddhavaṁsa* (Bv 5) [DharmaNexus].
